data_description.api_key: Google Maps Platform API key with the Weather API enabled.
data_description.map_type: Auto picks the US or EU precipitation map from the location.

error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Check that the Weather API is enabled for it.
error.cannot_connect: Could not fetch a map tile. Check connectivity and try again.
error.not_covered: This location is outside US/EU weather map coverage. Pick a map type explicitly or use a covered location.

abort.already_configured: A map for this location and type is already configured.

data_description.grid_size: Each refresh fetches N x N tiles; every tile is a billed API call.
data_description.update_interval: How often to fetch new tiles. 2x2 tiles every 15 minutes is roughly 11,700 calls per month.
